comment: PMC Operator fighters (docs/systems/pmc-squad-ai.md; PmcOperatorRules): the hostile operatives UPmcSquadSubsystem::SpawnFighter makes from the operative Blueprint. looks: coat_material = a material instance for the Explorer_Coat slot (made by Scripts/Editor/create_pmc_operator_variants.py under /Game/Characters/Enemies/PMC/Operator; a missing asset falls back to the tint alone), tint_srgb = the coat tint (the operative's role-colour parameter), snow = the starting snow share of the jacket. weapon_pool: weighted draw per fighter from Content/Data/Weapons (DA_Weapon_<id>). factions: monsters_attack_pmc = zombies / hounds hunt PMC fighters too; pmc_self_defence_m = a fighter shoots a monster only when it hunts a mate within this distance; cold_applies = the cold affects the PMC like the player's men (pending the user's confirmation).
